statements.action_statement: Use-after-free in xmlParseInternalSubset (DoS via crafted XML with improper entity resolution) affecting libxml2 2.9.11-2.11.0. The DHI package ships the Debian trixie 2.9.14 repack, which is in the affected range. Upstream fixed this only as a side effect of the entity-amplification rework in https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/commit/463bbeeca1805b5c4828f50d0fefc4eebaf620df (v2.11.0): a large parser.c rewrite plus ABI-changing additions to the public entities.h and parser.h structures. There is no isolated upstream patch, and neither Debian nor Ubuntu ships a backport to their 2.9.x branches. The fix cannot be applied to the 2.9.14 source without breaking API/ABI version compatibility for consumers, so no patch is carried. Reference: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-6653

Integer underflow and heap out-of-bounds read in berval2tl_data() in the LDAP KDB backend plugin (plugins/kdb/ldap/libkdb_ldap/ldap_principal2.c). Triggering requires a KDC or kadmind configured with an LDAP database backend whose backend returns a krbExtraData attribute with bv_len < 2; that data originates from the trusted KDB datastore, not from an external Kerberos protocol client, so it cannot be controlled by an adversary. Debian marks this unimportant (bug 1139821) with no security impact and notes it does not cross any security boundary.
